message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried pasta sheets (or no-boil sheets) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or a mix of beef and pork, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, tomato paste, olive oil, salt, pepper, oregano, basil, a splash of red wine (optional) |
| **Bechamel (white sauce)** | Butter, all‑purpose flour, milk, nutmeg, salt, pepper |
| **Cheeses** | Ricotta (or cottage cheese), shredded mozzarella, grated Parmesan (or Pecorino Romano) |
| **Seasonings & extras** | Salt, black pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, fresh parsley or basil for garnish |
| **Optional additions** | Sautéed spinach, sliced mushrooms, zucchini, or bell peppers; a pinch of red pepper flakes for heat |

**Basic assembly**: Layer cooked lasagna sheets with meat sauce, béchamel, ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan, repeating until the top is covered with cheese. Bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for about 35–45 minutes, or until bubbly and golden. Let it rest 10–15 minutes before serving.
